name: Sun Cleric: healing Tavara credits Help Tavara (#5558)
contract: Quest 9586 'Help Tavara' (quest_template.sql) requires RequiredNpcOrGo1 17551 (Tavara) x1, ObjectiveText1 'Heal Tavara'. Tavara's SmartAI (smart_scripts.sql, entryorguid 17551 source_type 0) only granted quest credit through SMART_EVENT_SPELLHIT rows naming stock spells 2050/2052 (Priest Lesser Heal), 59544 (Draenei racial Gift of the Naaru) and 139 (Priest Renew); Sun Cleric (class 27, a CoA-added class) shares none of them, so its baseline direct heal Illumination (500143, SPELL_EFFECT_HEAL, granted at class 27's level-0 baseline per AscensionLiveBaselineData.h) never triggered the SMART_ACTION_CALL_KILLEDMONSTER credit. rev_20260929_50_sun_cleric_help_tavara_heal.sql rewrites the full (17551,0) smart_scripts block, keeping the four existing rows and adding a fifth SMART_EVENT_SPELLHIT row for 500143 with the same action/target shape. Healing Tavara with Illumination must credit the quest objective.
